description: This file defines a benchmark class for testing grain communication with fanout patterns across multiple silos in an Orleans distributed system. It sets up silos and clients, manages their lifecycle, and includes methods for pinging grains and cleanup.

classes.name: FanoutBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for measuring Orleans grain communication patterns in a fanout setup across multiple silos, including setup, teardown, and benchmarking methods.

methods.name: FanoutBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor initializing silos and possibly a client, setting up event handlers for cancellation and exceptions.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that performs a ping operation on the grain.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Runs an infinite loop continuously pinging the grain.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully stops all hosts and the client, disposing resources.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements cleanup logic for the benchmark class, disposes clients and hosts, and unsubscribes event handlers.
